nodes.label: ropey::Rope buffers
nodes.desc: Documents are ropey 1.6 ropes built with the simd feature; edits splice rope slices, never whole strings.

nodes.label: Operation (Retain/Delete/Insert)
nodes.desc: ChangeSet is a list of these ops; adjacent same-kind ops are merged as they are pushed.

nodes.label: ChangeSet
nodes.desc: An ordered op list whose ops must re-sum to the original rope length, so any two ChangeSets can compose.

nodes.label: ChangeSet::apply
nodes.desc: Walks the rope once, applying Retain/Delete/Insert ops; returns false if the base text moved underneath.

nodes.label: Transaction
nodes.desc: A single undoable unit: a ChangeSet plus the optional Selection that should exist after applying.

nodes.label: Transaction::apply
nodes.desc: No-ops for an empty ChangeSet, otherwise delegates to ChangeSet::apply on the doc rope.

nodes.label: Range {anchor, head}
nodes.desc: Inclusive-left/exclusive-right range; anchor stays fixed, head moves when extending.

nodes.label: Selection
nodes.desc: SmallVec<[Range; 1]> of non-overlapping ranges plus primary_index; a selection is never empty.

nodes.label: Selection::primary
nodes.desc: Returns the range addressed by primary_index; push() makes each newly added range primary.

nodes.label: movement.rs primitives
nodes.desc: Word/char/line motion helpers that extend or collapse Range heads — the engine behind modal keys.

nodes.label: Syntax
nodes.desc: Wraps a tree_house::Syntax: a stack of language layers (injections) with their trees, 500 ms parse timeout.

nodes.label: Syntax::update
nodes.desc: Turns a ChangeSet into tree-sitter InputEdits and reparses incrementally instead of from scratch.

nodes.label: Loader
nodes.desc: Loads language configs, compiles highlights/injections/locals queries once (OnceLock), shared via ArcSwap.

nodes.label: Highlighter
nodes.desc: Iterates HighlightEvents across all tree layers so the UI paints spans without holding locks.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.desc: One buffer: rope text, per-view selections, history, syntax, inlay hints and its LSP clients.

nodes.label: Document::apply
nodes.desc: apply_inner: applies the Transaction, updates history and syntax; apply_temporary skips LSP sync.

nodes.label: Document::set_selection
nodes.desc: Stores one Selection per view id, so splits show independent cursors over the same rope.

nodes.label: Editor
nodes.desc: State hub: documents, views, config, theme, LSP registry handle and the event queue (EditorEvent).

nodes.label: Editor::open
nodes.desc: Reads a path into a Document, then focuses it in the current view with an Action (split/replace).

nodes.label: EditorEvent queue
nodes.desc: DocumentSaved, ConfigEvent, LanguageServerMessage, DebuggerEvent, IdleTimer, Redraw — via wait_event.

nodes.label: LSP handlers
nodes.desc: Editor hook that applies textDocument edits from servers and forwards didChange/didSave notifications.

nodes.label: Application
nodes.desc: Owns the terminal, compositor, Editor and Jobs; the single place all async sources are awaited.

nodes.label: Application::render
nodes.desc: Renders the compositor tree into a terminal buffer, then draws the cursor (box on head side).

nodes.label: Application::event_loop
nodes.desc: Renders once, then repeatedly runs event_loop_until_idle until it reports shutdown.

nodes.label: event_loop_until_idle
nodes.desc: tokio::select! biased over 6 sources: signals, input, job callbacks, status, futures, editor events.

nodes.label: handle_terminal_events
nodes.desc: Maps raw crossterm/termina events through the keymap and runs the matched MappableCommand.

nodes.label: handle_language_server_message
nodes.desc: Consumes server Calls from Registry.incoming: diagnostics, completions, edits, progress.

nodes.label: MappableCommand
nodes.desc: The command enum every key or macro maps to; execute() runs it with an editor Context.

nodes.label: default keymap
nodes.desc: Kakoune-flavored default binds: selection-first normal mode, no insert by default.

nodes.label: Registry
nodes.desc: SlotMap<LanguageServerId, Arc<Client>> keyed also by name; incoming: SelectAll of client streams.

nodes.label: Registry::get
nodes.desc: Resolves servers for a language config, reusing clients whose roots match the doc path.

nodes.label: Registry::start_client
nodes.desc: Spawns the server process, wires its receiver into incoming, and registers the id.

nodes.label: Client
nodes.desc: One server connection: process, reader/writer tasks, pending request map with timeouts.

nodes.label: Client::call
nodes.desc: Allocates a request id, registers the responder, and returns a future resolved by the reader task.
